```text
Create amazing AI designs without the effort or the cost
Generate branded and editable social media posts, presentations, flyers and more. No design knowledge or prompt skills required.
Sign up for free
One space to design everything
Create designs in any language, from quick marketing assets to text-heavy brochures.
How it works
Grafista is a content-first design platform. You add your text, images and branding and get complete designs in minutes.
1

Write, import, or generate content with AI.
2
Define the look and feel
Pick size, add instructions or choose a Blueprint.
3

Edit manually or ask the Agent for changes.
Meet
Blueprints
. The end of template editing.
Unlike traditional templates, blueprints aren't edited. They are references for generating designs. Grafista recreates the chosen blueprint using your content.
Search blueprints
Loading...
All the essential features you need
Generate text with AI
Import documents
Proofread instantly
Publish designs online
Export designs
Create with your team
```
